dimensions.assessment: Applies specifically in the event of a failed insured depository institution triggering a systemic risk determination, affecting federal banking agencies and Congress.
dimensions.evidence: in the event of the failure of an insured depository institution that leads to a systemic risk determination

dimensions.assessment: Involves retrospective reviews, examinations of mismanagement, and reporting on supervisory shortcomings.
dimensions.evidence: review and report to the Congress on the determination

dimensions.assessment: Does not specify new appropriations or fiscal outlays, focusing instead on reporting duties.
Amends the Federal Deposit Insurance Act to mandate specific retrospective oversight reports by banking agencies and the GAO.
dimensions.evidence: require reports on the use of the systemic risk authority

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory reporting requirement triggered whenever a relevant bank failure occurs.

missing_information: Exact administrative costs for conducting the mandated GAO and banking agency reviews are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes mandatory post-failure reporting requirements for regulators and the GAO following systemic risk determinations for insured depository institutions, improving transparency and accountability.

card.summary: The Main Street Capital Access Act modifies and lessens various banking regulations, adjusts capitalization requirements and asset thresholds for community banks and holding companies, and alters federal bank supervision, merger reviews, and resolution procedures.
card.title: Main Street Capital Access Act

card.label: H.R. 6644
card.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies federal housing programs and banking regulations to address housing supply, affordability, and regulatory hurdles. It creates pilot programs and grant initiatives for housing repairs, conversions of empty buildings, small-dollar mortgages, and manufactured housing without permanent chassis. It also adjusts environmental review rules under NEPA, alters bank investment limits, modifies the HOME Investment Partnerships program, and restricts the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency.
card.title: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act
